method: two executions of the same tool. Run 1 reused the Phase 2 revalidation read; run 3 performed its own full uncached read of live production (--drafts, no cache). The two outputs were compared field by field, not merely re-printed.
note: An earlier run 2 was DISCARDED: it was started before the PT-overwrite gate was corrected, so it executed older logic and legitimately differed on 4 gate fields. Its plan_digest, snapshot_digest, operation list, missing sources and slug collisions were already identical to run 1. Determinism is claimed here only from the like-for-like comparison above, and the two excluded fields are the wall-clock stamp and the output filename - run metadata, not plan content.
